summary: M0 model-only verdict: BENIGN @ 1.00. New device PH-9900 sign-in triggered the alert, but all signals are explained: same user, same ISP (Turkcell), same country (TR) and city (Manisa) as the established device LT-6002, indicating no impossible travel or foreign access. The new-device sign-in required and successfully completed MFA (mfa_approved, prompt count 1), so a password-only compromise is unlikely. No mail events are present to indicate post-compromise activity. Consistent with a legitimate new device (e.g., new phone) on the same local network/carrier. Not confirmed account takeover.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
